newsitem.title: CANADA: Dominion Textile to close Ireland plant.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Textile to close Ireland plant.

text.p: Dominion Textile Inc said on Friday that its wholly owned Klopman International subsidiary would close its plant in Tralee, Ireland effective October 31.
Dominion added that its fourth-quarter and year-end results to be released on August 19 would include an after-tax charge of C$21 million or $0.50 a share for the Klopman restructuring.

Dominion said its new manufacturing strategy, aimed at reducing costs and increasing competitiveness, included the closing of the Tralee plant and the recent downsizing of basic greige production at Klopman's plant in Frosinone, Italy, and the shifting of its reduced greige capacity toward more proprietary products.

It said the initial negative cash flow impact due to severance and closing costs was estimated to be C$12 million, while the restructuring was expected to generate annual savings, after local Italian taxes, of C$5.5 million or $0.13 a share.
The company said: "This announcement represents a very significant step in Klopman's restructuring and strategic market turnaround.

"This greige cost reduction program will materially increase Klopman's competitiveness in its largest market sectors while capitalizing on its strengths in product development, dyeing, finishing, marketing and distribution," it added.
